'''Pascuala García Martínez''' is a Spanish physicist and Professor of Optics at the [[University of Valencia]], where her research specialises in developing new optical and digital techniques for pattern recognition and imaging applications. She is a Fellow of the [[SPIE|International Society for Optics and Photonics (SPIE)]].

== Early life and education ==
García Martínez studied [[physics]] at the [[University of Valencia]], obtaining her bachelor's degree in 1993 and her PhD in 1998.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Ficha persona|url=https://www.uv.es/uvweb/universidad/es/ficha-persona-1285950309813.html?p2=garciap|access-date=2021-01-12|website=www.uv.es}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last1=García-Martínez|first1=Pascuala|last2=García|first2=Javier|last3=Ferreira|first3=Carlos|date=1995-06-15|title=A new criterion for determining the expansion center for circular-harmonic filters|url=https://dx.doi.org/10.1016%2F0030-4018%2895%2900122-O|journal=Optics Communications|language=en|volume=117|issue=5|pages=399–405|doi=10.1016/0030-4018(95)00122-O|issn=0030-4018|url-access=subscription}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=|title=CORRELACIONES MORFOLOGICA I NO LINEALS OBTINGUDES PER METODES OPTICODIGITALS|url=https://www.educacion.gob.es/teseo/createpdf?origen=3&idFicha=66435|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=2021-01-12|website=Gobierno de España, Ministerio de Educación, Cultura y Deporte}}</ref> She was a visiting doctoral researcher at [[Tel Aviv University]].<ref>{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=|title=Pascuala García Martínez|url=https://tecnopto.edu.umh.es/materiales/julia-arias/|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=2021-01-08|website=Universitat Miguel Hernández}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Shemer|first1=Amir|last2=Mendlovic|first2=David|last3=Zalevsky|first3=Zeev|last4=Garcia|first4=Javier|last5=Martinez|first5=Pascuala Garcia|date=1999-12-11|title=Superresolving optical system with time multiplexing and computer decoding|url=https://www.osapublishing.org/ao/abstract.cfm?uri=ao-38-35-7245|journal=Applied Optics|language=EN|volume=38|issue=35|pages=7245–7251|doi=10.1364/AO.38.007245|pmid=18324273|issn=2155-3165|url-access=subscription}}</ref>

== Research and career ==
In 1999, García Martínez became a postdoctoral researcher at the Center for Optics, Photonics and Lasers at [[Université Laval]].<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Garcia-Martinez|first1=Pascuala|last2=Arsenault|first2=Henri H.|last3=Roy|first3=Sébastien|date=2000-01-01|title=Optical implementation of the sliced orthogonal nonlinear generalized correlation for images degraded by nonoverlapping background noise|url=http://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0030401899006495|journal=Optics Communications|language=en|volume=173|issue=1|pages=185–193|doi=10.1016/S0030-4018(99)00649-5|issn=0030-4018|url-access=subscription}}</ref> She later returned to the [[University of Valencia]], where she is now Professor of [[Optics]] in the Department of Physics.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Pascuala Garcia-Martinez {{!}} Women in Optics {{!}} SPIE|url=https://spie.org/about-spie/advocacy/women-in-optics/women-in-optics-planner/2015-wio-planner/garcia-martinez-pascuala|access-date=2021-01-12|website=spie.org}}</ref>

Her research specialises in developing optical and digital methods for [[pattern recognition]] and image processing, for applications in [[holography]],<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Mico|first1=Vicente|last2=Zalevsky|first2=Zeev|last3=García-Martínez|first3=Pascuala|last4=García|first4=Javier|date=2006-02-10|title=Superresolved imaging in digital holography by superposition of tilted wavefronts|url=https://www.osapublishing.org/ao/abstract.cfm?uri=ao-45-5-822|journal=Applied Optics|language=EN|volume=45|issue=5|pages=822–828|doi=10.1364/AO.45.000822|pmid=16512523|issn=2155-3165|url-access=subscription}}</ref> [[optical camouflage]],<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Arsenault|first1=Henri H.|last2=García-Martínez|first2=Pascuala|date=2005-09-10|title=Intensity-invariant nonlinear filtering for detection in camouflage|url=https://www.osapublishing.org/ao/abstract.cfm?uri=ao-44-26-5483|journal=Applied Optics|language=EN|volume=44|issue=26|pages=5483–5490|doi=10.1364/AO.44.005483|pmid=16161663|issn=2155-3165|url-access=subscription}}</ref>  [[3D imaging]].<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Vallés|first1=José J.|last2=García-Martínez|first2=Pascuala|last3=García|first3=Javier|last4=Ferreira|first4=Carlos|date=2007-06-11|title=Phase Fourier vector model for scale invariant three-dimensional image detection|url=https://www.osapublishing.org/oe/abstract.cfm?uri=oe-15-12-7818|journal=Optics Express|language=EN|volume=15|issue=12|pages=7818–7825|doi=10.1364/OE.15.007818|pmid=19547109|issn=1094-4087|doi-access=free}}</ref> She also studies [[diffraction]] and [[Polarization (waves)|polarization]] in [[spatial light modulator]]s such as [[liquid crystals]]. Her research group works in collaboration with the [[Miguel Hernández University of Elche]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Pascuala García-Martínez|url=https://spie.org/profile/Pascuala.Garcia-Martinez-18370?SSO=1|access-date=2021-01-12|website=spie.org}}</ref>

== Awards and honours ==

* Fellow of [[The Optical Society|International Society for Optics and Photonics (SPIE)]], 2021<ref>{{Cite web|title=2021 SPIE Fellows|url=https://spie.org/membership/explore-membership/fellows?SSO=1|access-date=2021-01-12|website=spie.org}}</ref>
* President of the [[Spanish Royal Physics Society]]'s Women in Physics group, since 2018
* Senior member of [[The Optical Society]], 2015<ref>{{Cite web|last=ORCID|title=Pascuala García-Martínez (0000-0002-8537-281X)|url=https://orcid.org/0000-0002-8537-281X|access-date=2021-01-12|website=orcid.org|language=en}}</ref>

== Publications ==
García Martínez has co-authored six book chapters and over 100 articles in peer-reviewed academic journals.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Pascuala Garcia-Martinez|url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?hl=en&user=Lf_AgNUAAAAJ&view_op=list_works|access-date=2021-01-12|website=scholar.google.com}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Pascuala García-Martínez's Publons profile|url=https://publons.com/researcher/2731377/pascuala-garcia-martinez/|access-date=2021-01-12|website=publons.com|language=en}}</ref>
